A.description: Premium Grade - Exceptional appearance, zero severe defects, suitable for premium retail and export

B.description: Standard Industrial Grade - High quality, minor skin flaws acceptable for factory processing

C.description: Processing Grade - Moderate blemishes, suitable for starch extraction or immediate cooking

D.description: Below Grade - High defect incidence, rejected for standard commercial distribution

source: grading_rule_001 (AGMARK Standards & CPRI Commercial Grading Rules)
